# AccuVideo

> AccuVideo is a local-first video intelligence application that helps users search large video libraries by meaning rather than by scrubbing through timelines. It analyzes spoken words (via local Whisper transcription), on-screen text (OCR), and visual content (via a vision-language model) to answer natural-language questions and jump to the exact second in a video. Runs on Windows and macOS (Apple Silicon), with optional NVIDIA CUDA acceleration on Windows. Video files never leave the local machine — only abstract embeddings are stored in the search index.

## Product overview
- [Home](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/): Main product page — feature overview, demos, editions, pricing, and download links.

## Editions
- **Basic**: Semantic search over spoken words (Whisper transcription) and on-screen text (OCR). Multilingual transcription with optional translation for cross-language search. Optional NVIDIA CUDA acceleration bundled in-app. Ideal for individuals, students, and modest video collections.
- **Pro**: Everything in Basic plus visual content search (Florence-2 vision-language model), cross-modal re-ranking of audio + text + visual signals, the headless AccuVideoIngest CLI for large-scale batch processing, scheduled overnight ingestion, and multi-client LAN streaming. The Pro CUDA build is distributed as a separate external .zip (>2 GB) because of GitHub's asset size limit. Ideal for academies, corporate training, schools, and large archives.
- [Editions](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/#editions): Full Basic vs Pro comparison on the main site.

## Pricing
- 30-day free trial available for both editions (50 videos · 500 points · Basic by default; Pro on request).
- Paid plans are tied to the machine's hardware ID for security. Monthly and annual billing (annual = 2 months free).
- Basic plans: Starter, Personal, Freelance — by video and point capacity.
- Pro plans: Academy, Academy Plus, Enterprise — include concurrent LAN viewer allowances (15 / 45 / 150).
- [Pricing](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/#pricing): Live pricing with EUR/USD toggle and monthly/annual switch.

## Key features
- Semantic search over spoken words, on-screen text, and visual content — searchable in plain natural language.
- Exact-second navigation: results open the player at the frame that answers the query.
- 100% local processing: video files stay on disk. Only abstract embeddings reach the vector index, and each user's collection is fully isolated by license.
- Local transcription with Whisper — multilingual, with optional translation for cross-language search.
- Optional NVIDIA CUDA GPU acceleration on Windows (Basic bundles a DLL pack on demand; Pro ships as a separate CUDA build).
- In-app ingestion of folders (indexed in place, no copies) and drag-and-drop of individual files.
- AccuVideoIngest CLI (Pro): headless batch tool with resume-on-failure and Task Scheduler integration for overnight ingestion.
- Supported video formats: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, FLV, WebM, M4V, TS, MPEG.
- Multi-client LAN streaming in Pro — serve multiple concurrent viewers from a single indexing server.
- [Features](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/#features): Feature breakdown on the site.

## Hardware requirements
- [Hardware requirements (English)](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/requirements.html): Minimum and recommended specs for Windows, macOS, and Linux, plus ingestion timing benchmarks (Whisper + Florence-2), runtime RAM footprint, and multi-client setup guidance.
- [Requisitos de hardware (Español)](https://accuvideo.acornjuice.com/requisitos.html): Requisitos mínimos y recomendados para Windows, macOS y Linux en español.

## Platforms
- **Windows 10 / 11**: Full support. Optional NVIDIA CUDA acceleration (GPU with ≥6 GB VRAM, driver 525+). Distributed as .msi installer.
- **macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3)**: Native ARM64 build using PyTorch + Accelerate framework. MPS acceleration planned for a future release. Distributed as .pkg installer.
- **Linux (Ubuntu 20.04+ / Debian 11+)**: CPU-only ingestion supported. CUDA support on the roadmap.

## Use cases
- Online academies: search across hundreds of lessons to find the exact moment a topic was covered.
- Corporate training: skip to the relevant slide or discussion inside multi-hour all-hands recordings.
- Students: locate the moment a concept was explained in a recorded lecture.
- Families: search years of home footage semantically instead of scrubbing through files.
- Video archives without audio: Pro's visual indexing covers silent footage on its own.
